test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence :
Of the three paths, this is the __most shortest.__
solution:
The correct answer is '**shortest**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The given sentence uses the superlative degree to compare three paths.
 
• The correct superlative form of the adjective "short" is "**shortest**."
 
• Using "most shortest" is grammatically incorrect as it is redundant; the word "most" should not be used with superlative adjectives ending in "-est."
 
• Options 1 ("more short") and 3 ("most short") are also incorrect, as they do not follow the correct rules for forming comparative or superlative degrees for short adjectives.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Of the three paths, this is the **shortest**__."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "more short"** is incorrect because "short" is a one-syllable adjective, and its comparative form is "shorter," not "more short."
 
• **Option 2: "shorter"** is incorrect in this context because the sentence requires a superlative form, not a comparative form.
 
• **Option 3: "most short"** is incorrect because "most" should not be used with a superlative adjective ending in "-est."
 
• **Option 4: "shortest"** is correct because it is the proper superlative form of the adjective "short."
